newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Anshan buys two brokerages.
newsitem.headline: China's Anshan buys two brokerages.

text.p: Anshan Trust and Investment Co Ltd has bought two securities firms for 10.0 million yuan ($1.2 million), the Financial News said on Wednesday.
Anshan Trust, based in northeastern Liaoning province, had purchased the Anshan and Tianjin securities units of the Anshan Jingang Trust and Investment Co, the newspaper said.
The two units had estimated net assets of 10.4 million yuan and Anshan Trust had acquired the firms for 10.0 million yuan, it said.
Anshan Trust has A shares for domestic investors listed in Shanghai.
The provincial branch of the People's Bank of China, the central bank, had approved the deal, which was effective from January 1 this year.
